SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-18-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BALES, DANIELLE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VOGEL, PHILIP ORSON VOGEL, ANN AKA ANN ZAMBERUN OCCIDENTAL SERVICES, INC $4,592.00 PRINCIPAL, $270.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,862.00, PLAINTIFF HAD ACTUAL KNOWLEDGE OF ANTICIPATED CONSTRUCTION, AND I REJECT HER CLAIM FOR 30% OF RENT OVER 8 MONTHS, BUT I FIND THAT SHE WAS EFFECTIVELY OUSTED FROM HER UNIT FOR TWO WEEKS AND IS ENTITLED TO DAMAGES LESS THE FAIRMOUNT STAY. $341/NIGHT IS AN APPROPRIATE MEASURE OF DAMAGES. I ALSO AWARD $500 FOR DAMAGE TO PLAINTIFF'S FURNITURE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
